info.title: Email Hub API
info.description: Unified Gmail + Outlook inbox with AI analysis, an AI assistant, calendar scheduling and send/reply. Authenticate with an API key created in Settings → API access: `Authorization: Bearer ehk_live_...` (or the `x-api-key` header). All responses are wrapped as `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user, role, permissions, authentication method and granted scopes. Use it to verify a key.

patch.description:
Name, tour completion and onboarding progress.

Interactive login only (session or Supabase JWT); cannot be called with an API key.

get.description: Gmail and Outlook accounts connected by the user, with sync status. Tokens are never returned.

delete.description: Deletes the account and all of its synced emails and events.

post.description: Runs mail + calendar sync for every connected account (or one, if account_id is given) and returns per-account results.

analyze.description: Run AI analysis on new emails (defaults to AI_AUTO_ANALYZE)

get.description: Unified, newest-first list across all mailboxes with full-text search and AI filters. Paginate with limit/offset.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search over subject, sender and body

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: inbox | sent | archive | drafts | trash | spam

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: AI category, e.g. work, finance, meeting, newsletter

get.description: Events starting within the next N minutes across all calendars, soonest first, each with minutes_until_start. Pass refresh=true to re-pull the calendars from Google/Microsoft first (needs sync:trigger) so nothing added outside the hub is missed. Poll this every few minutes to drive reminders.

apiKey.description: Email Hub API key (prefix ehk_). Scopes: accounts:read (List connected mailboxes); accounts:write (Disconnect mailboxes); emails:read (Read and search emails and their AI analysis); emails:write (Send, reply, mark read/starred); calendar:read (Read calendar events); calendar:write (Create and delete calendar events / meetings); ai:use (Run AI analysis and the AI assistant); analytics:read (Read analytics summaries); sync:trigger (Trigger mailbox synchronisation)
